name: pan-wiggle
_comment: Poses are DEGREES (gripper: percent open). The first pose must name every calibrated joint; later poses name only what changes and inherit the rest. `pose` references a name from poses.json instead of `joints`.
_anchored: Generated from calibration.json: pose 'rest' IS this arm's captured rest pose, and joint 1 pans +/-15 deg from it with the arm folded. Re-generate after re-calibrating. Always `runner show` before `runner run`.
